note.full: SoWetin dey use AI understand wetin you type, answer cooking question, help draft recipe and read price report wey dem publish. Our AI na Google Gemini, and Google fit use wetin you type take improve their products, so no type private matter. AI no dey set price by himself. Our code dey check every price wey e read against where e get am, and our people dey go market check. AI fit make mistake, so e no get last word for allergy or health matter. We no dey send your name, email or phone number go the AI service.
note.chef: Chef na AI, e fit make mistake. For allergy matter, check the label and ask the seller.
note.craving: I use AI read wetin you type. If I no catch am well, tap one chip fix am.

ai.quota: You don ask plenty question today. Picks still dey work. Chef go come back tomorrow.

note.full: When you set allergy, we go hide any food wey get am for the recipe, even if na extra or "e fit get am" like seasoning cube. But na only our own recipe we fit see. Seller, restaurant or brand fit use another thing, so always check label and ask before you chop. If your allergy strong well well, follow wetin your doctor talk pass anything for this app.

When you order through Chopbaze, na Chopbaze and the vendor get the price, delivery money and whether food dey. No be SoWetin estimate. E fit change before you pay. Your order na between you, Chopbaze and the vendor.

sources.title: Where all this one come from
sources.intro: Some things wey you see for SoWetin come from outside: price report, YouTube video and partner menu. Some na we make am: recipe, plate idea and how we take combine price. See which one be which, and how far you fit trust each one.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.summary: For short: you no need account. Wetin you save dey your phone, we no fit see am. Wetin you type for craving or Chef dey go Google AI, and Google fit keep am, so no type private matter. The English below na the main one.

short.title: The short version
short.body: You don't need an account to use SoWetin. We don't ask for your name, email or phone number. What you save stays on your phone.

phone.title: What stays on your phone
phone.body: Your saved plates, your history, what's in your house, your chop personality, your settings, and any name or photo you put on a card all stay in your browser on this phone. We can't see them. To delete them, clear this site's data in your browser.

servers.title: What reaches our servers
servers.body: To pick plates, your phone sends your budget, how many people, cook or buy, meal time, your filters and what's in your house. We use them to answer, then let them go. We don't keep them or link them to you. Our host, Vercel, keeps short technical logs, like your IP address, to run and protect the service.

ai.title: What you type to the AI
ai.body: When you type a craving or ask Chef, the text goes to Google's Gemini AI so it can read it. We remove email addresses and phone numbers first. We use Gemini's free tier, so Google may keep what you type, use it to improve its products, and have people review it. Please don't type anything private. AI features are off for people in the European Union, the wider EEA, Switzerland and the United Kingdom.

videos.title: Videos
videos.body: Videos play in YouTube's privacy-enhanced player and only load when you tap one. Then YouTube's own privacy policy applies.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: We set one cookie, and only if you change the app's language, to remember your choice. Staff who sign in to our admin also get sign-in cookies. No ads, no tracking, no analytics.

helpers.title: Who helps us run SoWetin
helpers.body: Vercel hosts the app, with its servers in London. Supabase holds our food catalogue and prices in London. Google runs the AI. YouTube shows the videos you choose to play.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: Under Nigeria's Data Protection Act 2023 you can ask what we hold about you and ask us to correct or delete it. We don't keep personal data about people who use the app, so what's about you is on your phone, where you control it.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: When this changes, we'll update this page and the date at the top.

howWePrice.body: Every week, our AI dey read plenty market price report wey dem publish, and our code dey check every number against the page wey e come from. Every month, our people dey go Lagos market by themselves. We dey take the middle of all those prices, so one odd price no go scatter am, then we show range because price dey move and every seller different. The date go show you how fresh e be. E include the smallest amount wey seller go sell give you. Na estimate, no be final price, so your market fit different.
